rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, and it targeted the correct order (#W5270061 with the DC address). However, it performed order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating policy. Specifically, it modified the backpack and desk lamp immediately and unilaterally selected the gift card as the payment method for the modification charge, without confirmation. It then attempted to change the shipping address without explicit confirmation; the tool returned an error (non-pending order cannot be modified). The agent gave an incorrect reason for the failure (“after items have been modified” no further changes), which is unsupported by the tool result. It also refused later requests to change payment method based on the same unsupported rationale instead of checking status and permitted actions. These issues—missing confirmations before writes, unsupported/fabricated explanations, and unapproved payment method use—mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
